successors.name: Halaf culture
successors.text: the Tigris piedmont, where Tell Arpachiyah, Nineveh and Tepe Gawra are Halaf sites

successors.name: Samarra culture
successors.text: Tell Shemshara and Yarim Tepe, sites of both cultures

ledger.x: 6000 BCE: the Hassuna farmers hold the rain-fed piedmont of northern Iraq.
5350 BCE: the Hassuna villages end; the late Halaf and then the Ubaid take the piedmont.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture: radii around excavated villages, never a frontier.
